top_choice_rationale: P001 rewards the discovery of GLP-1 physiology and of the active GLP-1(7-36) peptide (Holst, Drucker, Mojsov), with decades of independent confirmation, approved agents and large randomised outcome trials, so maturity is not in doubt. The citation is scoped to discovery with therapy stated as consequence, and the three-person cap is respected. The contested priority of the active-peptide credit is a real weakness, but it does not outweigh the strength of the achievement relative to making no award.
